say:1:1831012001:1.text: Those dry fountains... <style="highlight">Something flows from them during a full moon</style>. And it isn't just the ones in the flower fields. There are more elsewhere.

say:2:1831012002:1.text: I saw it when I was alive. Red and thick... It looked like blood, but it wasn't. At least... I don't think it was.
say:2:1831012002:1.source_cn: 我活着的时候见过，红的，黏的……像血，但又不是血……不...

say:3:1831012003:1.text: Those fountains are cursed. Stay away from them... Stay away...
say:3:1831012003:1.source_cn: 它们都被诅咒了。别靠近……别靠近……
